title: task_breakdown.v1
description: Source of truth (D2) for the task-breakdown surface (strategy §4.2). Property order is the intended generation order (D3.3): parent_task_id (already established), ordered (a classification flag the model decides first), subtasks last (so each subtask's generation is conditioned on knowing whether order matters). Code assigns subtask importance from the parent's band (spec §4.1) - the model never manufactures sibling distinctions, it only emits `ordered` and each subtask's title/duration.

parent_task_id.description: Dynamic slot (D7): the single task id being broken down, known exactly at call time.
